components.text: The Displacement Rune increases the flow rate of $(blood)Life Essence$() into and out of the altar when pumping to and from an external Tank multiplicatively by +20%.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Displacement Rune to its augmented form, increasing the flow rate by a multiplicative +40% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
